answer: A Hardware security key bound by challenge-response signature with annual re-verification turns a private channel into public evidence: the hardware security key answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. Without this check, a signal of borrowed channels could flood the network overnight. When the ivory settles over the gale, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
